EV-000882

Packing 39 unit equilateral triangles in the smallest square · Packing · status current

Definition

s(39) = the smallest side of a square that contains 39 non-overlapping equilateral triangles of side 1.

s(39)=\min\{s:\ 39\text{ interior-disjoint unit equilateral triangles fit in }[0,s]^2\}

Domain: arrangements of unit equilateral triangles in a square. Normalisation: side length of the square; triangles have side 1; a trailing '+' marks a decimal printed truncated (true value slightly larger). Direction: min.

Current value

4.36792+ (record)

Source: E. Friedman, Erich's Packing Center, Triangles in Squares (page last modified 2026-10-09) https://erich-friedman.github.io/packing/triinsqu/ 2026-10-09
